scope: Read-only review limited to installer delta from prior install-review.json. Script was not executed; no host state, private configuration contents, provider credentials, tests, provider endpoints, DB, or browser were accessed.

dangling_path_preflight.detail: The new present(path) helper checks exists() or is_symlink(). Fresh namespace and inactive current-pointer guards now reject dangling symlinks before creating/replacing owned state. This closes the prior preflight ambiguity; exclusive mkdir/open behavior remains unchanged.

systemd_enable_link_recovery.detail: Recovery checks only the two expected enable locations for the new timer and status unit. It unlinks a path only if it is a symlink and its resolved target exactly equals the corresponding owned /etc/systemd/system/<unit> file. It retains all other links, release/source/state/history, then queues stop for the three owned units and Nginx reload. No pre-existing product unit or symlink target is eligible for removal.

delta_findings.unchanged_procedure: All other source remains as previously reviewed: exact source/package/owner-document pins, fresh isolated namespace and dedicated UID, exact owner digest import/review, own read-only loopback status, single canonical Nginx location, existing-product snapshot and readiness checks, and 3 GiB disk reserve.

retained_caveats: A failed activation deliberately retains partial files in the new owned namespace for readback and may require a separately reviewed continuation/cleanup before retry; existing product state is not overwritten.

The watcher starts asynchronously after public routing is checked. Activation PASS establishes install and status routing, not successful document retrieval; status can remain DEGRADED for operator-required sources.
Owner-supplied reviewed content does not establish automatic TLS provenance, freshness, or Performance/Seller identity binding.
deployment_gate: No new blocker in the reviewed delta. Prior procedure verdict remains applicable with the dangling-path preflight issue resolved. Use exact artifact/package checks and host preconditions before execution, and preserve failure receipts for readback.
